top_stories.title: IDScan confirms breach tied to 153 million stolen driver’s licenses
top_stories.summary: IDScan, an identity verification company, confirmed a breach in which hackers accessed customer data stored in its cloud platform. The breach is linked to a database containing over 153 million stolen driver's license scans.

top_stories.title: Attackers call employees’ personal phones to break into Microsoft 365 accounts
top_stories.summary: Microsoft Security Research has been tracking a social engineering campaign since May 2026 in which attackers impersonate internal IT staff via calls and texts to employees' personal phones to gain access to corporate Microsoft 365 accounts. Once access is obtained, threat actors exfiltrate data from SharePoint, OneDrive, and email inboxes over extended periods of weeks.

top_stories.title: MFA's Weakest Link: Account Recovery Is the New Attack Path
top_stories.summary: Attackers are increasingly bypassing MFA by targeting account recovery and password reset processes rather than the authentication mechanisms themselves. Specops outlines why stronger identity verification at the service desk is necessary to prevent social engineering attacks that exploit recovery workflows.

top_stories.title: Identity-Based AI Attack Threatens Security of Enterprise Data
top_stories.summary: A newly identified attack technique called "workflow identity hijacking" targets AI-based workflows by exploiting unauthenticated entry points to bypass standard security controls and access enterprise data. The attack leverages identity-based vulnerabilities in AI systems without requiring authenticated access, posing risks to organizations relying on AI-integrated workflows.

top_stories.title: The Top 4 Threats We Found by Investigating Every Alert for a Quarter
top_stories.summary: Prophet Security analyzed customer environment alerts over a three-month period (May–July 2026), finding that identity was the target in approximately half of all confirmed malicious activity. The report breaks down four main attack patterns observed, including why some identity-based attacks succeeded while others were blocked.

news.title: AI is changing what Salesforce security needs to govern
news.summary: WithSecure released a paper titled "Navigating Trust in the Modern Salesforce Ecosystem" examining how AI is expanding security governance requirements beyond traditional identity and access controls. The paper argues Salesforce environments now require governance of information dependencies, trust relationships across connected systems, and AI-driven actions and outcomes.

news.title: EU Cyber Resilience Act to Enforce New Reporting Requirements
news.summary: The EU Cyber Resilience Act begins enforcing a 24-hour mandatory reporting requirement for serious product security incidents affecting European organizations. This regulation introduces new compliance obligations relevant to IAM vendors and practitioners operating in the EU market.

news.title: Your passkeys can now move between password managers on Android
news.summary: Google has enabled a direct transfer feature in Android that allows passwords and passkeys to move between password managers without requiring an intermediate file download. The feature initiates from within the destination app and transfers data in encrypted form, eliminating the previous method of exporting to unencrypted text files.

news.title: CISA Flags Exploited Cisco, Citrix, Fortinet Flaws, Sets Sept. 12 Federal Patch Deadline
news.summary: CISA added three critical vulnerabilities affecting Cisco, Citrix, and Fortinet to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog, requiring federal agencies to patch by September 12, 2026. One of the flaws, CVE-2026-20079, carries a CVSS score of 10.0 and involves an authentication vulnerability.

news.title: Cisco confirms CVE-2026-20079 Secure FMC flaw exploited in attacks
news.summary: Cisco has confirmed active exploitation of CVE-2026-20079, a maximum-severity authentication bypass vulnerability in its Secure Firewall Management Center (FMC) software. The flaw allows attackers to bypass authentication controls, directly impacting access management security in affected Cisco firewall deployments.

news.title: Infostealer Logs Expose Replayable AI Tokens That Can Bypass MFA
news.summary: Cybercriminals are using infostealer malware logs (such as Lumma Stealer and Vidar) to harvest replayable session tokens and API keys from AI platforms like Google and Anthropic, enabling account takeover that bypasses MFA controls. The attack exploits the persistence of stolen session tokens, which remain valid even after password changes, effectively rendering MFA protections moot.

news.title: F5 BIG-IP APM Malware Injects a PHP Web Shell Into Memory, Evading Disk Scans
news.summary: Sophos published an analysis revealing malware targeting F5 BIG-IP Access Policy Manager (APM) appliances that injects a PHP web shell into memory to evade disk-based detection. The malware modifies in-memory copies of PHP scripts loaded by Apache, meaning file integrity checks return clean results while the system remains compromised.

news.title: SailPoint, Inc. Q2 2027 Earnings Call Summary
news.summary: SailPoint held its Q2 2027 earnings call, with a summary provided by Moby. No specific financial figures, product announcements, or strategic details are available from the description provided.

news.title: SailPoint Q2 Earnings Call Highlights
news.summary: SailPoint reported its fiscal Q2 earnings, with ARR rising 25% year over year to $1.231 billion and revenue increasing 17% to $309 million. SaaS ARR grew 36%, with overall performance exceeding expectations.

news.title: Dear SailPoint Stock Fans, Mark Your Calendars for September 9
news.summary: SailPoint is scheduled to report its fiscal Q2 earnings on September 9. Investors are monitoring whether growing demand for identity security solutions is translating into improved profitability for the IAM vendor.

news.title: Orchid Security gives enterprises a kill switch for rogue AI agents
news.summary: Orchid Security has added identity drift detection and application-level kill switches for AI agents to its Identity Control Plane product. The new controls allow security teams to revoke or restrict AI agent access and permissions at the application level.

news.title: Commvault Introduces Active Directory Pre Recover, Enabling Near-Real-Time Access to Trusted Identity Services During Cyberattacks
news.summary: Commvault has launched Active Directory Pre Recover, a solution designed to restore access to Active Directory identity services in near-real-time during cyberattacks. The product addresses scenarios where identity infrastructure is compromised, coupling recovery speed with recovery cleanliness to maintain access to critical systems.

news.title: Okta Earnings, AI Offerings Drive Shares Up 94% YTD
news.summary: Okta's shares have risen 94% year-to-date, driven by strong earnings and AI-related offerings. The stock gains reflect increased demand for Okta's identity security products and AI capabilities.

news.title: firezone headless-client-1.5.12
news.summary: Firezone has released headless-client version 1.5.12 of its enterprise zero-trust access platform built on WireGuard. The release represents an incremental update to the open-source zero-trust networking solution that provides secure access management capabilities.

news.title: Autonomous AI Agents Compromise Thousands of Credentials in Under Six Hours
news.summary: A financially motivated threat actor used an autonomous multi-agent AI framework to conduct a large-scale credential harvesting campaign, compromising thousands of credentials in under six hours. Google Threat Intelligence Group (GTIG) observed the attack, highlighting the use of AI to accelerate credential theft operations at scale.

news.title: Microsoft Plugs Nearly 1,000 Security Holes
news.summary: Microsoft released a record-breaking patch batch addressing at least 974 security vulnerabilities across Windows and other software. The company attributed the accelerated vulnerability discovery pace to AI tooling, while security experts note organizations are struggling to prioritize and deploy the high volume of fixes.

news.title: eMazzanti Technologies' Messaging Architects Partners with miniOrange to Deliver Unified Identity and Access Management for Legacy and Hybrid IT Environments
news.summary: eMazzanti Technologies' Messaging Architects division has partnered with miniOrange to deliver IAM solutions including SSO, MFA, PAM, and Zero Trust for legacy and hybrid IT environments. The partnership targets organizations running on-premises systems, GroupWise, and mixed SaaS environments.

news.title: Old, Unpatched Flaws Give Attackers Access to Philippines Nuclear Agency
news.summary: Threat actors exploited unpatched vulnerabilities in ownCloud to breach the Philippines Nuclear Agency, stealing credential stores among other data. The attack leveraged commodity vulnerabilities to gain initial access, resulting in the exfiltration of personnel records and reactor databases.

news.title: Attackers Pounce on Critical Artifactory Bug Following Disclosure
news.summary: A critical authentication bypass vulnerability (CVE-2026-82329) has been disclosed in JFrog Artifactory, allowing attackers to gain admin-level access on affected systems. Exploitation attempts have been observed following public disclosure of the flaw.

news.title: FBI Probes Service Selling 153M+ Drivers Licenses
news.summary: A dark web service is selling digital scans of over 153 million U.S. and Canadian drivers licenses, allegedly sourced from a Louisiana-based identity verification company. The FBI's New Orleans field office has opened an official inquiry into the breach of the identity verification provider.

news.title: Canadian Man Pleads Guilty in Snowflake Extortions
news.summary: Canadian cybercriminal Connor Riley Moucka pleaded guilty to computer fraud and conspiracy charges related to hacking and extorting over 165 organizations using Snowflake's cloud data storage platform. The attacks resulted in the theft of data including over 100 million AT&T customer call and text records.

news.title: Lessons Learned from CISA’s Recent GitHub Leak
news.summary: CISA released a postmortem report on a data breach in which a contractor accidentally published dozens of internal credentials, including AWS GovCloud keys, to a public GitHub repository for nearly six months. The incident highlights credential management failures and gaps in secrets detection practices relevant to IAM and PAM professionals.
